🎥🎬: Game Night (2018)

Max and Annie are a competitive couple who love hosting game nights with their friends. Their lives take an unexpected turn when Max’s wealthy brother, Brooks, organizes an elaborate murder-mystery game where one of them will supposedly be kidnapped.

But when Brooks is actually abducted by real criminals, everyone assumes it is part of the game. As Max and Annie try to solve the mystery, they realize the danger is real and that they have no idea who they can trust.

What follows is a chaotic night filled with criminals, mistaken identities, unexpected twists, and hilarious attempts to figure out what’s actually happening.

source_details.synopsis: Game Night is a 2018 American action comedy film directed by John Francis Daley and Jonathan Goldstein and written by Mark Perez. It stars Jason Bateman and Rachel McAdams, and the film's supporting cast includes Billy Magnussen, Sharon Horgan, Lamorne Morris, Kylie Bunbury, Jesse Plemons, Michael C. Hall, and Kyle Chandler. The film follows a group of friends whose game night turns into a real-life mystery after one of them is kidnapped. Warner Bros. Pictures released the film on February 23, 2018. It received positive reviews from critics and has grossed $122 million worldwide. Plemons was nominated for the Detroit Film Critics Society Award for Best Supporting Actor.
